## What Problem Is Being Solved?

Waste sorting is essential for recycling but is often done manually. This project explores automated trash classification from images.

## How It Works

A **binary image classification** project using deep learning to distinguish trash categories from photographs.

## My Role

Researcher and developer of the classification model.

## What Was Produced

Classification model code and experiments.
